title: No task matches the columns
basic_text: Rastai couldn't tell what this data is for from its columns.
fix_text: Rename the columns, or pick the task yourself.

title: Data command not available yet
message: {command_id} isn't available in this version of Rastai yet.
basic_text: This feature is planned but not built yet in this version of Rastai.
fix_text: Nothing to fix on your side: the feature arrives in a later version.

title: File format not recognized; no converter
message: The format of {path} isn't recognized, and no converter reads it.
basic_text: Rastai doesn't know how to read this file.
fix_text: Convert it to JSON Lines or CSV, or install a converter.

title: More than 1% of rows failed conversion
message: {failed_rows} of {total_rows} rows failed conversion, more than 1%.
basic_text: Too many rows in this file couldn't be read.
fix_text: Check the rows the report lists.

title: Python converter raised
basic_text: The converter that reads this file failed.
fix_text: Check the file, or report it to the converter's author.

title: Image larger than the decode limit
message: The image {path} is larger than the decode limit.
basic_text: This image is too large to read safely.

title: Exact duplicates dropped
basic_text: Rastai removed rows that appeared more than once.

title: Train/test leakage found
message: {count} test rows also appear in the training split.
basic_text: Some test examples are also in the training data, so test scores would be too high.

title: Possible PII found
basic_text: This data may contain personal information, like names or email addresses.
fix_text: Review the rows the report lists.

title: Source missing or not readable
basic_text: Rastai couldn't read this file or data source.
fix_text: Check that it exists and that you can read it.

title: HF dataset gated or download failed
message: The Hugging Face dataset {repository} is gated or its download failed: {reason}.
fix_text: Accept the dataset's terms on Hugging Face, then try again.

title: Source changed since the check
message: {path} changed since it was checked (its hash differs).
basic_text: This data changed after Rastai checked it.

title: MySQL source unreachable
basic_text: Rastai couldn't read your MySQL data source.
fix_text: Check that the server is running and reachable.

title: MySQL login rejected
message: The MySQL source {connection_name} rejected the login.
basic_text: Rastai couldn't read your MySQL data source. The login was refused.
fix_text: Check the user name and password.

title: MySQL source refused by the TLS policy
message: The MySQL source {connection_name} has no TLS and isn't loopback or a Unix socket, so it is refused.
basic_text: Rastai won't read data over an unencrypted connection.
fix_text: Turn on TLS on the MySQL server.

title: MySQL query failed
basic_text: Rastai couldn't read your MySQL data source. The query failed.

title: MySQL column type has no row in the type-mapping table
message: The MySQL column {column} has the type {column_type}, which Rastai can't map.
basic_text: One column in this table has a type Rastai can't read.
fix_text: Leave the column out, or cast it in the query.

title: Run-log format version not supported
message: The run log {path} has format version {version}, which isn't supported.
basic_text: This run log was made by a version of Rastai this one can't read.

title: Corrupt run-log record; that source run skipped
message: A record of {source_run_id} in {path} is corrupt; that run was skipped.
basic_text: One run in this log is damaged, so Rastai skipped it.
